{"notes": "Visit 4 (4:00). Table: top line intact. Bottom line now looks connected end to end, so the gap is closed, but I don't know who closed it. Tail is still a rounded curl with no pointed fin. A dark stray loop (x19-21, y9-13) and a vertical line (x~20.5, y12-14.7) are still attached. A pale disconnected curve runs down to y~18, which is probably the off-pad vertical line.

LEO: Said twice that he's laying the fin and claims he cleared the stray loop. I see no fin, and the loop is still there. Possibly he cleared only a right-hand piece at the tail. Priya says a takedown of his hit near the tail. His communication to Priya was clear and honest about scope. Pattern: claims ahead of visible output. Execution on the fin is unproven. Ask for a demo.

MAYA: Spoke up this visit. Stopped tracing when level with Priya, deferred the join twice without friction, and moved to the tail. Told Tom to clear the pale loop. Reliable, collaborative, self-aware. Her bottom line is done and matches what I saw.

TOM: Claimed the join privately and told Maya to leave it. Priya claimed the same join, so they duplicated effort. He hasn't publicly acknowledged Priya's request to clear the vertical line and help Leo. Still no verified output from him, including the nose check. Ask exactly what he did.

PRIYA: Accurate status (body one run, remaining: fin, stray loop, vertical line). Coordinates and delegates clearly, and avoided doubling up. Bottom line is closed, though I can't attribute it. Strong collaboration.

Next: fin exists? Loop and vertical line cleared? Tom's contribution? Who did the join?"}
